verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only developer building blocks. These are an API endpoint to retrieve a transcription (not stated to cover voicemails) and a tutorial for importing voicemail files into your own infrastructure. Nothing documents Aircall itself transcribing voicemails and delivering them to email or chat, and developer primitives do not count toward the story.

support.subject: As a founder, voicemails are transcribed and delivered to email or chat so I can read them without dialing in
